== Emerald Weapon Changes ==

* Tokens can now be found on the following monsters in Hasla & Karkasse. Monsters will drop 1-2 tokens
** Karkasse
*** Lavahorn Ox
*** Ancient Spirit
*** Haunted Blade
*** Karkasse Twinhead Viper
** Hasla
*** Kosan Heirs Miscreant
*** Spotted Centipede
*** Hooded Helltrap
* Drill Camp Monsters will now drop 1 extra token, making it 3 per monster
* See the pictures below for the new locations. Red => 1-2 tokens, Pink => 3 tokens + rift event at 18:00 ingame.

== Double Double Event ==

The following rates have been doubled:
* 2x EXP, Honor, Vocation, Prestige
* 2x Family EXP, Guild EXP

== Technical: Instance Capacity Increase ==

* As some players have noticed over the past 3 days, sometimes starting an instance would display a message regarding a temporary server overload. We have increased our instance capacity by 5x and have some room for even more if needed.
